data.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in London
data.detailed_description:
🥰 101 Cats in London invites you on a cozy journey to find cats hidden in a beautiful hand-crafted landscape inspired by travels around the world. 🗺️

🍂 Explore a calm and relaxing hidden objects experience full of cats, where every corner may hide cute hidden cats waiting to be discovered. Perfect for players who enjoy cozy, calm, zen games about animals and peaceful exploration.

🎵 While searching for hidden pets and hidden cats, enjoy a tranquil soundtrack designed to help you relax and unwind.

😸 Earn TONS of achievements while discovering every cute animal hidden in the scenery.

🏆 Become the ULTIMATE CHALLENGER and invite your friends to see who can find cats the fastest! ⏱️

GAMEPLAY:

🐾 It’s 101 hidden cats in a single beautiful landscape — a world full of cats waiting to be discovered.
👉 Click on every hidden cat you find.
👀 Adjust brightness for a more relaxing and comfortable experience. ✅
🔎 Use the AMAZING ZOOM to spot the tiniest hidden objects and sneaky kitties.

😺 A cozy, calm and zen animal adventure for players who love cute cats, relaxing exploration, and hidden object challenges.

Perfect for fans of Hidden Objects, Animal Fest, and cozy discovery games during Sale events.

😺🐾🐈 😻
